lines.cap: The alpha male is a lie. And the man who made it famous took it back.

lines.cap: The story goes: every wolf pack is ruled by an alpha, who fought his way to the top.
lines.say: The story goes: every wolf pack is ruled by an alpha, who fought his way to the top.

lines.cap: That idea came from studies of captive wolves. Strangers, thrown together in a zoo enclosure.
lines.say: That idea came from studies of captive wolves. Strangers, thrown together in a zoo enclosure.

lines.cap: Of course they fought. They weren't a family.
lines.say: Of course they fought. They weren't a family.

lines.cap: In 1970, biologist David Mech wrote a famous book using the word alpha. It sold for decades.
lines.say: In 1970, biologist David Mech wrote a famous book using the word alpha. It sold for decades.

lines.cap: But then he spent years watching wild wolves in the Arctic. And saw something else.
lines.say: But then he spent years watching wild wolves in the Arctic. And saw something else.

lines.cap: A wild pack is a family. A mother and father, and their pups. The leaders are just the parents.
lines.say: A wild pack is a family. A mother and father, and their pups. The leaders are just the parents.

lines.cap: Mech has spent decades asking people to stop using alpha. He even asked his publisher to stop printing the book.

lines.cap: So the real alpha? He's just a dad.
